decisions.rationale: Three spruce variants 18-22.5 m (natural size), lod0 trunk and branch wood 680-864 triangles plus 1,826-2,196 triangles of alpha-tested needle cards, and a 6-triangle crossed-card impostor each; darker palette after the dev review.

Dense dark Greenmarch and Hollowvale forest at 18-40 m cameras: the canopy cone cutaway keeps the hero and the ground around them visible; impostors from 58 m fade as their cards turn edge-on (no horizontal-card lines).
